english: It is not however the case that there would be any ripening of a deep seed—the potential for a state of mind that took on the aspect of a strand of hair—with those who saw the object but had no cataracts. It is not though the case that this state of mind would fail to grow because it was devoid of any entity which possessed an existing object which was a strand of hair. Suppose then that this were your position. The present has no potential on its own
